title: Observation
summary: A recorded or directly noticed feature of an event or state, described with enough context to distinguish what was observed from an interpretation.
definition: An observation is produced through a sensing or measurement process and is shaped by instruments, procedures, resolution, and the observer's categories. It is not automatically theory-free.
learning_outcomes: Distinguish a description of an observation from an explanation of it.
Record relevant context, units, method, and limitations.
